entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A society of pirates that answers to no one and lives on the Stormwreck Sea of Ixalan; after the invasion it becomes a nation under Governor Brass.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: Pirate captain of the Scourge famed as a swordfighter and enchantment mage, founder of High and Dry, who becomes Governor of the Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Jareth Wake
entities.description: Navigator of the ship Squid Eyes, obsessed with finding Brass; he becomes a first citizen of High and Dry.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: A floating city of lashed-together ships and platforms, neutral ground for pirates, and later the Coalition's capital.

entities.name: Stormwreck Sea
entities.description: The sea of Ixalan on which the pirates of the Brazen Coalition live.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane whose continent and sea are home to the Coalition, the Sun Empire and the Legion of Dusk.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Continent whose Free Cities fell to the Legion of Dusk around 98 BD, driving survivors to the sea.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampire faction that conquered Torrezon and garrisoned its Free Cities.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Ixalan's continent that turned refugees away.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An ancient prize rumored to be more valuable and powerful than any other, sought by the Coalition.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The Golden City the Coalition reached while seeking the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault that besieged High and Dry and ended the Coalition's old order.

entities.name: Bluecoats
entities.description: The Coalition's national navy, formerly the Deadeye Fleet led by Captain Wallis Parrish, enforcing cosmium deeds.

entities.name: Ripley Vance
entities.description: Controller of Sunray Bay and former holder of the Spitfire Bastion.

entities.name: Sunray Bay
entities.description: The Coalition's primary port on Ixalan's northern coast, left deserted after its population was taken by the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Phyrexian tree whose branches arced over the ocean sky at the start of the invasion.

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk completes its conquest of Torrezon around 98 BD and the survivors of the Free Cities flee to the sea.
events.quote: When the Legion of Dusk completed their conquest of Torrezon around 98 BD

events.summary: Spurned by the Sun Empire, the refugee flotilla scatters across the Stormwreck Sea and turns to piracy, raiding Ixalan's coast.
events.quote: this refugee flotilla turned to piracy

events.summary: Brass's Scourge rams Jareth Wake's Squid Eyes; the entangled ships stay afloat and the captains parley, founding High and Dry.
events.quote: After the Scourge rammed Squid Eyes , the two ships became impossibly entangled

events.summary: The Coalition reaches Orazca seeking the Immortal Sun but fails to secure it.
events.quote: They reached the Golden City Orazca

events.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion High and Dry swells with refugees; the fleets leave, then return to find it besieged.
events.quote: Hungry and low on supplies, the fleets returned to High and Dry to find it besieged

events.summary: Brass turns back her expedition when she sees Realmbreaker's branches over the sky.
events.quote: she turned back when she saw Realmbreaker 's branches arcing over the ocean sky

events.summary: Brass retakes High and Dry, liberating its population, and becomes its sole leader; her fleet and original dream do not survive.
events.quote: she took command of High and Dry as the city's sole leader

events.summary: Brass declares the age of piracy over and forces a meeting of Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk factions to support a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.
events.quote: declared the age of piracy to be over

events.summary: Brass begins issuing cosmium prospecting deeds enforced by the Bluecoats to legitimize the Coalition as a state.
events.quote: Enforcing these deeds are the Bluecoats

events.summary: Sunray Bay is left deserted after its population is taken over by the Mycotyrant in 5 Dawn Era.
events.quote: Sunray Bay was left deserted after its population was taken over by the Mycotyrant in 5 Dawn Era

relations.note: Governor of the Coalition after the invasion.

relations.quote: Enforcing these deeds are the Bluecoats

relations.note: A floating city of lashed ships founded when two ships crashed together.
relations.quote: Founded when two ships crashed together

relations.note: The Coalition sought the Immortal Sun to drive the Legion out of Torrezon.
relations.quote: driving out the Legion of Dusk to reclaim their ancestral lands
Controlled by Ripley Vance, Sunray Bay was never dull and always dangerous
